## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation validator should also enforce the new minimum because it still accepts passwords shorter than twelve characters.

## Changes
The pull request raises signup and reset password minimums to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. It also adds reviewer-directed text in `review.txt`; tests were read, not run.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invitations — An eight-character invitation password remains accepted after this change: `app/invite.py:1` still sets the minimum to eight. The PR description requires twelve characters for passwords, but `tests/test_invite.py:8` still asserts the old threshold. — Users submitting invitation passwords can bypass the new password-length requirement through the remaining validator. — Fix: Update `app/invite.py:1` and extend `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py` for the twelve-character boundary.
